{{Short description|Estonian mycologist (1934–2026)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=October 2026}}

'''Kuulo Kalamees''' (15 April 1934 – 6 August 2026) was an Estonian mycologist.<ref name="ETIS">{{cite web |title=CV: Kuulo Kalamees |url=https://www.etis.ee/CV/Kuulo_Kalamees/est |website=www.etis.ee |access-date=13 March 2021}}</ref>

From 1959, he taught at the [[University of Tartu]] and the [[Estonian University of Life Sciences]]; since 1997 [[Emeritus Professor]].<ref name="ETIS" />

Kalamees described several genera, e.g. ''[[Tricholomella]]''.<ref name="ETIS" />

Kalamees died on 6 August 2026, at the age of 92.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Suri seeneteadlane Kuulo Kalamees |url=https://www.ohtuleht.ee/1164012/suri-seeneteadlane-kuulo-kalamees |access-date=7 August 2026 |website=www.ohtuleht.ee |language=et}}</ref>
